alpha-unique.comment: LOWERED on 2026-08-16, 4758015856 to 3703471500 instructions. The wire decoder decided a tag by asking petta_py_tag/2 whether it was o, then s, then g, then n, re-running atom/1 and string/1 at every step, so a single ['n',1] leaf cost nine inferences to recognise. Normalising the tag once and dispatching on it lets first-argument indexing pick the clause: a number leaf falls to 4.00 and a three-element expression 29.00 to 20.00. Attributed by interleaved A/B of that change alone, min-of-3 instructions:u: 4133301509 to 3703607237, -10.40%. This workload evaluates one large nested term per operation, so the per-node saving compounds over every node crossing the wire. LOWERED again on 2026-08-16, 3703471500 to 3587525535, and the drop is not a speed-up: this case is now measured in STEADY STATE. benchmarks/pure.py runs its operation once before the counters start, so the engine's one-time global-stack growth is no longer inside the measured interval. That growth was the whole of the bimodality recorded below.
alpha-unique.instruction_noise_comment: LOWERED back to 1.0 on 2026-08-16, matching every other bench, because the bimodality it was raised for is GONE rather than tolerated. benchmarks/pure.py now warms this case up, which was named as the sharper fix when the 12% was recorded, and it holds: adding ten inert clauses to src/python.pl used to move the count from 4176751912 to 3772644013 and back, alternating, three rounds, and with the warm-up the same two trees measure 3587527424 and 3585946931, a 0.05% step instead of a 10.7% one. The warm-up is per case, declared in pure.py's _WARM_UP, because a warm-up changes what a workload MEANS wherever its second run differs from its first: source-load run twice measures redefining a thousand equations rather than defining them. Two attributions made against the old 12% ceiling are void, and are corrected in ai-design-grounded-view.md: neither the writer's clause shape nor the tuple guard's allocation was worth the 400 million instructions claimed for it. Both changes are still right on their own terms; only the numbers were cluster assignment.

json-wire.comment: RE-FLOORED 2026-08-17 from 3753315597: the codec changed, not the cost of the old one. dumps and loads now cross into the engine and run library(json), so one round trip pays two janus crossings and two Prolog passes, 62M instructions per trip against the removed orjson path's 1.9M, a factor of 33 on this bench. The wire paths this serves are network-latency-dominated DAS and remote-space messages, and the trade bought one JSON implementation for the whole system with unbounded integers native. register-op.comment: Raised from 39705 on 2026-08-17, +2 per registration: each registration parses its declaration form through the named-space reader, so it pays the same two-inference &self probe run-source records [measured 2026-08-17]. Prior: Raised from 36605 on 2026-08-18, +3100 over 100 register-and-unregister cycles, +31.0 per cycle, all of it at SETUP. Registration now compiles the operation FROM its contract atoms: the Python keywords assert (op Name Arity Kind), (effect Name immutable) and (inverse Name) into &petta first, and petta_py_compile_op reads them back and builds the clause through the same petta_py_op_body/petta_py_directed_body builders as before, clause-identical by construction and held so by the exhaustive parameter-cube gate (test_contract_cube.py, 44 points plus a planted mismatch). Nothing was added to any call path, which the unchanged op-raw and op-encoded rows confirm. The 36605 floor itself was set the same day by the petta_py_existed indexed-probe fix, so the net move against the 2026-08-16 baseline of 47307 is -7602.

Measured by hot-swapping the pre-cascade body into the live process: the same thousand-directive loop went 340013 to 338015 [measured 2026-08-17]. Prior: Raised from 340019 on 2026-08-17, +2 per directive: every runnable aggregates through petta_prune_empty/2 (Empty is the branch remover, LeaTTa Minimal/Interpreter.lean:3090), a negated C memberchk gate plus the identity walk only when something unified. An in-goal \== filter variant measured lower here but cost nilbc 2.1x upstream by changing the findall goal's compiled shape, so the after-the-findall walk is the kept form.

save-load-fast.instruction_comment: ADDED on 2026-08-16. This benchmark had an inference baseline and no instruction one, and it is the byte-copying path: it writes a whole 20,001-atom space to a file as text and reads it back. The inference counter cannot see byte copying, which this ledger measured directly once (string-join moved 4x in inferences and 476x in wall clock for one change), so a change that doubled the bytes written would have passed the gate in silence. Wall clock is the other instrument that sees it and is unusable on this box under load; instructions:u sees the copying and does not move with the load, which is why this is the gate rather than a timing.

save-load-metta.comment: Raised again from 9002155 to 9002433 on 2026-08-16, +278 over the same 20001 atoms, which is ONE indexed lookup per parsed form on the empty metta_token/2 table. It buys bind! being what the specification says it is: "(-> Symbol %Undefined% (->)) ... Registers a new token which is replaced with an atom during the parsing of the rest of the program". PeTTa's bind! accepted only (new-state V) and FAILED SILENTLY on anything else, so (bind! six 6) did nothing and the language's own idiom (bind! abs (py-atom numpy.absolute)) then (abs -5) could not work. A lookup is the floor for a table that must be consulted per form: the walk itself runs only once a token exists, and the expression path was cut back to this lookup alone rather than the whole parsed-form rewrite, which took save-load-metta from +80,284 to +278. Guarded by python_surface in tests/prolog/python_surface.plt.

source-load.comment: Raised from 940155 on 2026-08-17, +2 per form from the &self reader cascade in rewrite_parsed_form/4: a named-space form pays two inferences to probe its own source text for the token (the CLI's &self space short-circuits before any real call). Measured by hot-swapping the pre-cascade body into the live process: the same thousand-directive loop went 340013 to 338015 [measured 2026-08-17]. Prior: LOWERED on 2026-08-16, 6921403 to 939162 inferences and 4,248,161,895 to 942,633,712 instructions, 7.5x and 4.5x. Compiling an equation fired metta_on_function_changed/1, and the handler answered "which stored definitions mention this name" by SCANNING every equation in the system, so a load was quadratic in its own length and the scan was almost the whole of it: a thousand equations cost 7,330,334 inferences with it and 822,578 without. definition_mentions/2 in src/filereader.pl indexes the answer by the mentioned symbol, recorded once where the equation is, so the question is a first-argument lookup. Lowered rather than left: a ceiling eight times above the floor lets an eightfold regression through without a word. Raised from 939162 to 940155 on 2026-08-16, +993 over the same 1000 equations, which is ONE indexed lookup per parsed form on the empty metta_token/2 table, the same cost save-load-metta took above and for the same feature. A form now asks two questions before anything reads it, are there py-call aliases and are there bound tokens, where it used to ask only the first; both guards are inline in rewrite_parsed_form/2 in src/metta.pl so the second costs its lookup and no call frame. Collapsing the two into one would take a cached "something is registered" flag, and a stale flag there does not cost speed, it silently drops a bind! substitution. One inference per form is the honest price of the feature.
source-load.instruction_comment: RE-FLOORED 2026-08-17 from 942633712 (+1.7%): not a code change. The old floor was one of two alignment modes selected by the caller's environment-block size (stable 957.6M under check.sh against a stable low mode under a bare shell, inference counter identical); the deterministic harness pins one mode and this is its floor. Presizing SWI stacks instead was measured and rejected: it distorted the engine's own GC economics, save-load-metta +2.35%.

typed-call.instruction_noise_comment: RAISED to 5.0 on 2026-08-17, from the 1.0 every other bench carries, because this workload's instruction count is LAYOUT-sensitive at 3.13% and nothing in the tree selects the mode. Ten clauses that NOTHING CALLS, appended to src/python.pl, moved it from 6590121734 to 6390136042, and removing them moved it back. A sweep of the same probe reads 6590121734, 6558144686, 6462134810, 6518142057, 6438133781, 6390136042 at 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10 clauses, saturating there and unchanged at 20, so it is a continuum rather than the two modes alpha-unique had [measured 2026-08-17]. The INFERENCE count is identical across every one of them, which is what says no logical work ever changed. This is code-layout bias, the effect Mytkowicz, Diwan, Hauswirth and Sweeney measured in 'Producing Wrong Data Without Doing Anything Obviously Wrong!' (ASPLOS 2009), where link order and environment size alone move a benchmark by several percent and can reverse a conclusion. alpha-unique's warm-up does NOT fix this one: with typed-call added to pure.py's _WARM_UP the same two trees still measure 6591481484 and 6391492325, so the mode is not the one-time stack growth that was, and the warm-up was reverted rather than left in for nothing. The allowance is measured rather than guessed, and the ceiling still sees what it exists for: this bench is gated in instructions because the inference counter cannot see the type-check specialisation, and disabling that specialisation by one token measures 9368378515, +42.2% against a 3.13% noise floor, a 13x margin [measured 2026-08-17]. The baseline stays at the LOW end of the layout range rather than being re-recorded at the tree's current value, so a real regression sitting on top of the high mode still fails.

counter_policy: stats().inferences minimum of three and fixed two-point growth slopes decide; wall time advises
instruction_policy: perf instructions:u minimum of three, one percent noise allowance, measured under a deterministic harness since 2026-08-17: the child environment is a fixed allowlist, PYTHONHASHSEED is 0, and setarch -R disables address-space randomization, because environment-block size, hash seeds and ASLR each selected alignment modes that moved counts up to 1.5% with the inference counter flat. All floors re-measured under that harness on 2026-08-17.
